species.name: Trout
why: Water 56°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 24–40 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 90 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Walleye
why: Water 56°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 18–38 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 60 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 90 ft, so fish stay above it.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.
